news.title: Record chip rally adds $2 trillion in combined value to Micron, Intel and AMD in second quarter
news.detail: Wall Street poured into chipmakers not named Nvidia in the second quarter, as the artificial intelligence boom expanded to include more suppliers.

news.title: Where to find top CD yields in the second half as Fed policy remains murky
news.detail: Banks are fine-tuning their approach toward deposits, with some trimming rates on high-yield savings accounts while others lift rates on CDs.

news.title: 优步投资的Lime据悉确定IPO发行价为25美元
news.detail: 据知情人士透露，Neutron HoldingsInc．（更广为人知的名字是Lime）已将其首次公开募股（IPO）定价为每股25美元，处于此前公布的发行价区间中位。

news.title: 日本首相设定目标 争取到2040财年名义GDP达到6.8万亿美元
news.detail: 日本首相高市早苗设定目标，争取到2040年财年名义国内生产总值（GDP）扩大到6.8万亿美元，其中约五分之一将来自国内民间资本投资。

news.title: 数字基础设施公司ITG美国IPO定价低于区间，筹资3.122亿美元
news.detail: 由橡树资本（Oaktree）支持的ITG周二表示，其美国首次公开募股（IPO）定价为每股16美元，低于目标区间，共筹集3.122亿美元。

news.title: Nike results top estimates even as China sales drop 12%; retailer expects $986 million tariff refund
news.detail: Nike was expected to report another quarter of declining sales as the sneaker giant struggles to regain strength under its turnaround strategy.

news.title: 盖蒂图片社因英国监管部门审查 取消了与Shutterstock的37亿美元合并计划
news.detail: 盖蒂图片社周二表示，由于英国竞争监管机构将出售Shutterstock的编辑业务作为批准合并的条件，该公司已取消与Shutterstock的合并计划。

news.title: 韩国6月出口额首次突破1000亿美元，芯片出口飙升近两倍
news.detail: 韩国产业通商资源部周三公布的数据显示，受创纪录芯片出口的推动，韩国6月份月度出口额首次突破1000亿美元大关，创下历史新高。

news.title: Michael Burry says he's shorting Caterpillar for the first time after it nearly doubled in the AI-driven rally of 2026
news.detail: "Caterpillar jumped out at me," Burry said. "I have never shorted Caterpillar. It has always done great for me on the long side in the past."

news.title: China-linked actors target more than technology as AI competition with U.S. intensifies
news.detail: Cyberattacks from China-based entities are on the rise and not just targeting specific tech, analysts warn, as the U.S. AI race intensifies.
